courses.name: Hinode Driving Grounds
courses.sectorsBrief: Wide apron into a gentle slalom; a banked demonstration bend; separate drift circle and recovery bay
courses.defaultConditions: Dry daylight with a separately selected wet practice section
courses.designNote: The skid pad is not part of a paid race route; six independent training bays and a shared non-contact loop.

courses.name: Tea Lantern Road
courses.sectorsBrief: Broad opening left; two mild alternating bends through fields; one clearly sighted hairpin before a flat finish
courses.designNote: Teach braking and exit speed; broad safe shoulders, no blind punishment on the first race.

courses.name: Mizuhana Switchback
courses.sectorsBrief: Village-edge acceleration; five deliberately unequal hairpins; an opening-radius final S
courses.designNote: Different climbing ratios matter; never mirror the same hairpin five times.

courses.name: Canal Orchard Ring
courses.sectorsBrief: Canal-side sweep; tight orchard offset; raised bridge braking into long exit
courses.designNote: Provide a genuinely closed loop, clear lap gates and a distinct overpass silhouette.

courses.name: Bellmaker Descent
courses.sectorsBrief: Fast hill shoulder; compression into linked corners; late double-apex right by workshops
courses.designNote: Lieutenant rematch location; visually teach not every entrance should be attacked at full speed.

courses.name: Cedar Ribbon
courses.sectorsBrief: Dark cedar corridor; three rhythm esses; an open overlook followed by an off-camber turn
courses.designNote: Foliage density varies by sector; readable edge reflectors and uncluttered apexes.

courses.name: Shrine Approach
courses.sectorsBrief: Long braking approach; steep zigzag below a wooded ridge; final paired bends onto a plateau
courses.designNote: The event uses the access road, not a sacred courtyard; retain cultural specificity without decorative nonsense.

courses.name: Mistglass Hollow
courses.sectorsBrief: Long visible entry sweeps; low valley mist over straight sections; tightening woodland sequence
courses.defaultConditions: Cool mist with maintained apex visibility
courses.designNote: Fog is atmospheric and telegraphed; never conceal road geometry beyond the safe stopping sight line.

courses.name: Rain Thread Pass
courses.sectorsBrief: Sheltered launch; wet cambered arcs; short tunnel into a long drainage-side descent
courses.designNote: Wet sheen, grip and AI line agree; no randomly placed invisible ice.

courses.name: Spillway Run
courses.sectorsBrief: Dam-crest crosswind section; braking past spillway gates; sheltered rising exit bends
courses.designNote: Crosswind is primarily audiovisual in the baseline; do not add untested random steering forces.

courses.name: Hydroline Climb
courses.sectorsBrief: Powerhouse launch; multi-radius climbing turns; fast final shelf road
courses.designNote: Sustained ascent differentiates torque/gearing; road markings and power assets are original.

courses.name: Floodmark Circuit
courses.sectorsBrief: Lakeside kink; stepped retaining-wall sector; wide pump-yard exit
courses.designNote: No impossible loop connection: use a separate service viaduct to return to the starting basin.

courses.name: Blackwater Hairpins
courses.sectorsBrief: Quiet launch shelf; asymmetrical hairpin ladder; long braking turn after a tunnel
courses.designNote: A late-boss course: descent rhythm and brake release matter more than maximum power.

courses.name: Saltwind Viaduct
courses.sectorsBrief: Rising sea viaduct; linked cliff arcs; slow port-side finishing chicane
courses.designNote: Fast sectors have safe barrier continuity and visibly different sea/land edges.

courses.name: Fishmarket Midnight
courses.sectorsBrief: Closed warehouse lane; market-roof S bends; quay-side braking into a square turn
courses.designNote: No active pedestrians or public traffic on the closed course; scenery extends beyond fence lines.

courses.name: Tide Lantern Coast
courses.sectorsBrief: Upland sweep; sea-wall undulations; three late-apex corners by the inlet
courses.designNote: Road crowns and wet patches are authored/consistent for every entrant.

courses.name: Breakwater Ascent
courses.sectorsBrief: Harbour launch; steep cliff zigzag; broad high-road acceleration to finish
courses.designNote: Course rises out of the port instead of copying a forest track with a sea skybox.

courses.name: Slatecut Service Road
courses.sectorsBrief: Concrete loading apron; rock-cut alternating bends; a bridge over an inactive quarry
courses.designNote: Road is paved and closed; gravel shoulder has a clear physical boundary.

courses.name: Kilnlight Ring
courses.sectorsBrief: Broad kiln approach; tight cooling-yard loop; under-bridge compression with safe sight line
courses.designNote: Warm industrial windows and cooler exterior lighting create material contrast without neon overload.

courses.name: Switchyard Skyline
courses.sectorsBrief: Reservoir-link approach; descending-radius arcs beside pylons; climbing final hairpin group
courses.designNote: Rhythm changes deliberately; no endless straight that decides the event solely by top speed.

courses.name: Ember Quarry Drop
courses.sectorsBrief: High quarry shelf; alternating braking/compression; long final descent into workshop valley
courses.designNote: Final lieutenant location; fast road has broad recovery zones before the most severe bends.

courses.name: Moonridge Contour
courses.sectorsBrief: Open ridge arcs; old snow-shed transition; fast plateau S section
courses.designNote: Cold visual palette without automatically adding ice; headlight falloff remains readable.

courses.name: White Pine Descent
courses.sectorsBrief: Pine-lined openers; long cambered descent; final triple bend around a frozen-looking rock face
courses.designNote: Frost on scenery is not road ice; road-grip state is explicit and consistent.

courses.name: Signal Tower Climb
courses.sectorsBrief: Low antenna valley; steep and slow middle; high-flow ridge approach
courses.designNote: Acceleration cannot replace a good exit; apex lighting makes the final climb learnable.

courses.name: Four Signals Traverse
courses.sectorsBrief: Four different sectors: technical entry; sustained drift arcs; braking descent; smooth high-road finish
courses.designNote: Normal regular race first; S29 reuses the course with explicit four-contract mastery judging, not a new course ID.

courses.name: Amanagi Dawnline
courses.sectorsBrief: Ridge launch and linked switchbacks; long horizon sweep into tunnels; changing-radius descent into sunrise
courses.defaultConditions: Normal: night to dawn lighting; Hard: authored mist clearing into dawn
courses.designNote: At least five sectors and a unique route; lighting progression is deterministic, never changed grip or hidden hazards during the race.
